findings.text: follow-on: the negative-control log's own revision header reads "revision: c98a0d42dc8195dd60c9c145340703409c87b2ec" (the base) while the run executed the head test file, whose assertion at tests/standard_names/test_source_migration_conflict.py:154 checks SourceMigrationConflictError, so a reader pairing the control with a revision by its header attaches the proving run to the wrong tree, and the same header appears in negative-control-binding.log.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base c98a0d42dc8195dd60c9c145340703409c87b2ec; the single commit 288db9e2f adds the base class and rewires both subclasses in imas_codex/standard_names/provenance_lifecycle.py (+55/-15), widens two assertions to the base in tests/standard_names/test_source_migration_conflict.py (+5/-2) and adds the landing fragment docs/evidence/fragments/sn-integrity-backlog/sib-conflict-base.html (+32), changing no unrequested production behaviour.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when asks for the transient tests to fail under a mutated transient row with an EXIT log, all existing callers and tests to pass, and base/after suites carrying revision/exit_status/completed:true; the reviewed run's base-gate.log and head-gate.log both end "83 passed, 2 deselected" EXIT=0, negative-control-binding.log and negative-control-retired.log each end "4 failed" EXIT=1 with the four transient-fault ids listed FAILED, and manifest.md records baseline_suite/after_suite both completed:true with failure_count 0.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is one adjudicable-conflict base every named migration outcome derives from, supplying only its message; provenance_lifecycle.py:73-100 adds SourceMigrationConflictError carrying the conflicts tuple and the detail join once and both SourceBindingConflictError and SourceRetiredSuccessorConflictError now subclass it, and my own construction of both subclasses returned identical messages to the pre-change format and isinstance(base) True for each.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; manifest.md records status complete, commit 288db9e2f, changed_paths matching the diff, base/after suites with revision, exit_status 0 and completed:true, the two negative-control logs, and module.__file__/measurement_cwd naming the worktree for the mutated arms; one record defect in the negative-control logs' own revision headers, named in the finding below.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares orientation_write_paths = imas_codex/standard_names/provenance_lifecycle.py, tests/standard_names/test_source_migration_conflict.py and docs/evidence/fragments/sn-integrity-backlog/sib-conflict-base.html (a docs/figures entry unused), and the single commit 288db9e2f touches exactly those three files, so every landed path is inside the declared scope.

justifications.durability: negative-control-retired.log shows the assertion at tests/standard_names/test_source_migration_conflict.py:154 reddening ("assert not True" where isinstance of SourceRetiredSuccessorConflictError is checked against SourceMigrationConflictError) for all four transient cases, so widening the exclusion to the base is a real guard that fails if a transient row is misclassified into either named type.
justifications.evidence: base-gate.log and head-gate.log record "83 passed, 2 deselected" EXIT=0 at c98a0d42d and 288db9e2f and both negative-control logs record "4 failed" EXIT=1, so the gate measures the done_when, but the head arm's revision is recorded short (288db9e2f) beside the base's full sha and the negative-control headers misname the tree measured, both noted below.
justifications.fit: the added base at provenance_lifecycle.py:73 follows the module's existing class-and-docstring idiom, is named for the meaning it carries rather than either subtype, and introduces no plan, ticket or version label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: provenance_lifecycle.py:73 defines SourceMigrationConflictError and lines 100 and 126 make both named types subclass it, with the conflicts tuple and detail join carried once at line 87-89 exactly as the goal states.
justifications.reuse: the change consolidates two byte-identical __init__ bodies into the owner it creates at provenance_lifecycle.py:73 rather than duplicating any capability, and a search of imas_codex/standard_names for an existing adjudicable-conflict base found only unrelated RuntimeError subclasses that share no tuple-carrying contract.
justifications.scope_discipline: commit 288db9e2f changes only imas_codex/standard_names/provenance_lifecycle.py, tests/standard_names/test_source_migration_conflict.py and docs/evidence/fragments/sn-integrity-backlog/sib-conflict-base.html, all three declared in the manifest and nothing outside them.
